-- Defines are Lua, not PDXscript: each line stands alone and there is NO comma

# TEMPLATE generated by Hagane Works (domain: common/peace_conference/cost_modifiers).
# STARTING POINT — point `enable` at your case, tune cost_multiplier, and VERIFY IN-GAME.
# Scripted COST MODIFIERS for peace-conference actions. All modifiers active on an
# action MULTIPLY together — keep values near 1.0 (roughly 0.4-3.0; must be > 0).
# Scopes available inside `enable` (peace-conference specific):
#   ROOT           = negotiator (whose conference turn it is)
#   FROM           = taker (owner AFTER the conference)
#   FROM.FROM      = giver (owner BEFORE the conference)
#   FROM.FROM.FROM = the state (for state-targeted actions)
# peace_action_type: take_states / puppet / force_government / liberate — one token
# or an array like { puppet liberate }.
# Ownership/diplomacy do NOT update mid-conference: use the pc_* triggers
# (e.g. pc_is_puppeted_by) to check conference-time facts.
# This file MERGES additively with the base game's modifiers (net-new names only).
peace_action_modifiers = {

	my_peace_claim_discount = {
		# `category` groups rows in the cost tooltip; an unknown category lands under
		# "other". Vanilla categories: is_core / has_claim / occupation / ideology / ...
		category = has_claim
		peace_action_type = take_states

		enable = {
			# Active when the taker has a claim on the state being taken.
			FROM.FROM.FROM = { is_claimed_by = ROOT.FROM }
		}

		# 1.0 = deliberately a NO-OP until you tune it (0.9 = 10% cheaper,
		# 1.5 = 50% dearer). Must be > 0.
		cost_multiplier = 1.0
	}
}
